preconditions: continuous deformation and discontinuities are classified separately
structural observations use compatible coordinates and orientation conventions
logic: Apply one compatible continuous map to all pre-existing contacts affected by a fold or strain event
Require positive sampled Jacobian determinant for continuous maps
Represent a fault as a piecewise displacement operator d*f1 with explicit surface, direction, magnitude and extent evidence
Apply structural events in geological time order
Do not generate folds from a generic sine wave or faults from decorative crossings
hardGates: no local inversion or collapse in continuous domains
consistent displacement of every affected contact
validationMethod: rigid-motion, positive-Jacobian, collapse, finite-extent, consistent-offset and missing-evidence tests
reopenCondition: A mechanics-based fold/fault constitutive model is selected with adequate boundary-condition evidence
